name: quoxbox-macmini
tagline: The only AI that can use your Mac — and pass an audit.
description: QuoxBox is a governed gateway between Quox and an always-on Mac mini. Every screen read, click, and keystroke runs through a policy engine (R1-R15) that enforces human-in-the-loop approval on high-risk actions, verifies the effect of every step, and writes a tamper-evident evidence chain. Watch the agent work live, launch governed workflows ("tasks"), and approve or deny risky steps from the dashboard — no API access required for the automated app or portal.
shortDescription: Governed, verifiable control of an always-on Mac — HITL approval, effect-verification, tamper-evident evidence.
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Governed R1-R15 policy engine — every action is checked before it runs, not after
Human-in-the-loop approval on any high-risk step, right from the dashboard
Effect-verification confirms each action actually happened before moving on
Tamper-evident evidence chain for every session — built for EU AI Act oversight
Automate no-API portals and desktop apps without giving the agent unattended keys to the kingdom

liveWatch.name: Live Watch
liveWatch.description: Real-time view of the Mac mini's mode, screen-lock state, capture availability, kill-switch, and circuit breaker — refreshed continuously.

governedTasks.name: Governed Tasks
governedTasks.description: Launch pre-registered workflows against the Mac mini with typed parameters. Track each step's status (done, failed, awaiting approval, denied) live.

hitlApprovals.name: HITL Approvals
hitlApprovals.description: High-impact steps pause and wait for a human decision. Approve or deny inline, with the tool, impact, reasoning, and rollback plan shown for every request.

evidenceFeed.name: Evidence Feed
evidenceFeed.description: A live, tamper-evident feed of every action the agent takes — allow/deny decisions, verified effects, and mode changes — chained for audit.

modeControl.name: Mode Control
modeControl.description: Switch the gateway between readonly, propose (hold every action for approval), and actuate (run automatically within policy) from the dashboard.

defaultMode.label: Default Gateway Mode
defaultMode.description: Mode the gateway starts in for new sessions

options.label: Propose — every action held for approval

requireApprovalAboveImpact.label: Require Approval Above Impact Level
requireApprovalAboveImpact.description: Minimum impact level that always requires human approval, regardless of mode

changes: Governed task launcher with typed workflow params
